verdict.rationale: Granola documents a real in-meeting disclosure feature: it posts a message in the meeting chat when it starts transcribing to let everyone know, under a dedicated 'transparency solutions' section of its consent docs. That satisfies the story's in-meeting disclosure option with a shipped capability rather than a policy document. Missing for 10: evidence that admins can enforce or mandate the disclosure workspace-wide, detail on which meeting platforms or configurations support the chat message, coverage of bot-less mobile and in-person capture, and independent hands-on corroboration.
